changelog: **Per-organization white-label: logo upload, generated app icons, host-resolved brand (#2922):** an organization can now carry its whole visual brand as data. New nullable `Organization.brandTileColor` / `brandAccent` / `brandPalette` / `brandMarkVersion` and a `BrandAsset` table (registered tenant model). An admin uploads one square mark (`POST`/`DELETE /api/admin/organizations/[id]/brand-mark`, gated exactly like the branding PATCH: that org's ADMIN or a super admin of its world, `WHITE_LABEL` for upload, delete always allowed); SVG passes a strict validator (`src/lib/svgMark.ts`) and is rasterized, never served; PNG/WebP are content-sniffed and pixel-limited. One renderer (`src/lib/brandRender.ts`, now shared with `scripts/generate-pwa-images.ts`) generates the manifest icons, maskable and apple-touch icons, favicon, shortcut icons and all 17 iOS launch images, served from `/brand/<version>/<kind>.png` (allowlisted kinds, immutable, `nosniff`, versions carry no org id). The pure rule `src/lib/brandRule.ts` decides the source — the host's mapped org (`publicHost`) when it is the host's own product and carries brand data, the signed-in person's own org on signed-in pages, else the vertical default, field by field — and `src/lib/hostBrand.ts` feeds the manifest, `<head>` icons/launch images/theme-color, `<html data-accent>` (an organization palette bridged through `--brand-*` variables), the brand mark components, mail logo, push icon, share card and JSON-LD logo. A default brand takes the exact code path it took before: with no host mapped and no new column set, every host renders byte-identical output. The admin White-label card gains the mark upload, tile colour, default accent (incl. "Organization colour") and a super-admin-only palette; account settings offer "Organization colour" when the org has a palette. `prisma/set-public-host.mjs --list` reports brand completeness per mapped org; `sharp` is now an explicit dependency.

en: Organizations can upload their logo mark and get a complete set of app icons generated from it — home-screen and maskable icons, favicon, shortcut icons and iOS launch screens — plus a tile colour, a default accent and, optionally, their own colour palette that members can pick as "Organization colour".
tr: Kurumlar logo işaretlerini yükleyip ondan üretilmiş eksiksiz bir uygulama simgesi seti alabilir — ana ekran ve maskelenebilir simgeler, favicon, kısayol simgeleri ve iOS açılış ekranları — ayrıca bir zemin rengi, varsayılan vurgu rengi ve isteğe bağlı olarak üyelerin "Kurum rengi" diye seçebileceği kendi renk paletleri.
de: Organisationen können ihr Logo-Zeichen hochladen und erhalten daraus einen vollständigen Satz App-Icons — Homescreen- und maskierbare Icons, Favicon, Shortcut-Icons und iOS-Startbildschirme — dazu eine Kachelfarbe, eine Standard-Akzentfarbe und auf Wunsch eine eigene Farbpalette, die Mitglieder als „Organisationsfarbe“ wählen können.
